sections.title: سبق 28 — متن (134)

paras.text: The Celt nation first of all made Andalus its homeland. After it the Iberian, Ligurian and Phoenician nations are mentioned. After them the people of Carthage established their government there. Their era is 247 BC. After them the Greeks entered, and then the Romans came. The Romans made splendid reforms in Andalus. Progress took place in the various departments of life. Their famous rulers were Trajan and Theodosius. Seneca in philosophy and Lucan in dialogue-writing made a name. Martial was the famous poet of this era. The Romans remained in power until the 5th century CE. The Goth nation, defeating them, took possession of the country. During this time the Vandals, passing through France, entered Andalus, and after remaining in power over its southern parts for approximately 18 years went to Africa. From their connection Spain began to be called Vandalicia (Vandallca) or Andalish, which later came to be called Andalusa or Andalus. The Greeks called it Iberia and the Romans Hispania. The Arabs remember it by the name of al-Andalus al-'Uzma.

sections.title: سبق 28 — متن (135)

paras.text: … and in the south the Strait of Gibraltar is situated. Its length is approximately 1770 kilometres, breadth 966 kilometres, and total area comes to approximately 17 lakh kilometres. Approximately 200 years before the arrival of the Muslims the Visigoth (Goth) nation, defeating the Romans, had established its government here. The Romans were civilised, but the Goths were savage, bloodthirsty and ignorant. Benefiting from the Latins they laid the foundation of their sultanate. They paid special attention to agriculture. A leading military officer said: "Andalus in the beauty of sky and earth resembles Syria; in the delicacy of water and air, Yemen; in perfumes, India; in fertility, Egypt; and in precious minerals (metals), China."

… and in the south the Strait of Gibraltar is situated. Its length is approximately 1770 kilometres, breadth 966 kilometres, and total area comes to approximately 17 lakh kilometres. Approximately 200 years before the arrival of the Muslims the Visigoth (Goth) nation, defeating the Romans, had established its government here. The Romans were civilised, but the Goths were savage, bloodthirsty and ignorant. Benefiting from the Latins they laid the foundation of their sultanate. They paid special attention to agriculture. A leading military officer said: "Andalus in the beauty of sky and earth resembles Syria; in the delicacy of water and air, Yemen; in perfumes, India; in fertility, Egypt; and in precious minerals (metals), China."

Social and communal condition of Andalus before the Muslims:

According to Stanley Lane-Poole, savage tribes, the Visigoth Goths, were rulers over Andalus. In Andalus the amirs remained drowned in pleasures. Their life was devoted to eating, drinking and other pleasures. The majority of the public consisted of slaves, who kept working day and night in the fields, but nothing of it was their own. With time their masters kept changing. Between these two classes the most oppressed class was that of the slaves, on whom pressure kept falling from both sides. They had to pay the greater part of the country's taxes. This class provided the means of pleasure for the amirs. The whole business of government too this class had to run. In society such people had disappeared who could face attackers. The amirs and nobles had drowned in their colourful pleasures. Their swords had become rusty. They were running far away from war. sections.heading: سبق 28 — متن (135)
sections.text:
جنوب میں آبنائے جبرالٹر واقع ہے۔ اس کا طول تقریباً ۱۷۷۰ کلومیٹر، عرض ۹۶۶ کلومیٹر ہے اور کل رقبہ تقریباً ۱۷ لاکھ کلومیٹر بنتا ہے۔ مسلمانوں کی آمد سے تقریباً ۲۰۰ سال پہلے قوط (گاتھ) قوم نے رومیوں کو شکست دے کر یہاں اپنی حکومت قائم کی تھی۔ رومن مہذب تھے لیکن گاتھ وحشی خونخوار اور جاہل تھے۔ انہوں نے لاطینیوں سے استفادہ کر کے اپنی سلطنت کی بنیاد رکھی۔ زراعت پر خاص توجہ دی۔ ایک سرکردہ فوجی افسر نے کہا، ”اندلس آسمان اور زمین کی خوبصورتی میں شام سے مشابہ ہے۔ آب و ہوا کی لطافت میں یمن سے، خوشبویات میں ہند سے، زرخیزی میں مصر سے اور بیش بہا فلزات (دھاتوں) میں چین سے مشابہ ہے۔“

مسلمانوں سے قبل اندلس کی سماجی و معاشرتی حالت:

سٹین لے پول کے مطابق اندلس پر وحشی قبائل وزی گاتھ یا ولسٹ گاتھ حکمران تھے۔ اندلس میں امراء عیاشیوں میں ڈوبے رہتے تھے۔ ان کی زندگی کھانے پینے اور دوسری عیاشیوں کے لئے وقف تھی۔ عوام کی اکثریت غلاموں پر مشتمل تھی جو رات دن کھیتوں میں کام کرتے رہتے تھے، لیکن ان کا اپنا کچھ بھی نہیں تھا۔ وقت کے ساتھ ساتھ ان کے آقا بدلتے رہتے تھے۔ ان دونوں طبقوں کے درمیان مظلوم ترین طبقہ غلاموں کا تھا جس پر دونوں طرف سے دباؤ پڑتا رہتا تھا۔ ملک کے ٹیکسوں کا بڑا حصہ ان کو ادا کرنا پڑتا تھا۔ یہ طبقہ امراء کے لئے عیاشیوں کا سامان مہیا کرتا تھا۔ حکومت کا تمام کاروبار بھی اس طبقے کو چلانا پڑتا تھا۔ معاشرے میں ایسے لوگ ناپید ہو گئے تھے جو حملہ آوروں کا مقابلہ کر سکتے۔ امراء اور شرفاء اپنی رنگینیوں میں ڈوب گئے تھے۔ ان کی تلواریں زنگ آلود ہو چکی تھیں۔ وہ جنگ سے دور بھاگ رہے تھے۔ ملک میں منظم اور
